sources.title: Consolidated banking statistics (BIS CBS), international claims by reporting bank nationality and immediate counterparty country
sources.observedPeriod: Quarterly bank international claims outstanding; selected country series through 2026-Q1; current data portal vintage retrieved 2026-10-14
sources.revision: Queried BIS SDMX REST API v2 dataset BIS,WS_CBS_PUB,1.0. Filter: quarterly; amounts outstanding/stocks; reporting-bank nationality; international claims; all instruments; all maturities; all booking currencies; all counterparty sectors; immediate counterparty basis. Individual series codes and extraction stored in global-network-exposure.json. Re-queried with a single bounded SDMX API v2 request at 2026-10-14T17:21:59Z; 7 numeric observations returned in requested selected set. This refresh supersedes unsupported 18:50:00Z timestamp; raw response archived under retrievals/bis/.
sources.units: USD millions in source (multiplier 6); converted to USD billions in extracted table
sources.scopeAndLimits: Gross consolidated international claims, not net bilateral positions, funding flows, country total external debt, or ultimate-risk positions. Immediate-counterparty basis can differ from guarantor basis. National reporting coverage varies; no causal pass-through inferred. NaN observations retained as suppressed/not published, never converted to zero. Current refresh returned 7 numeric series only for FR/GB nationalities against DE/CH/US counterpart residents; no numeric CN, CH or US reporter rows were returned in the selected combination query. Non-return is not zero and is not a complete survey of reporter availability.

sources.title: Strengthening economic resilience within global value chains in Switzerland
sources.publisher: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
sources.observedPeriod: Foreign-input reliance primarily 2018 input-output data; import concentration 2002–2021; report published 2024
sources.revision: OECD Economic Surveys: Switzerland 2024, global-value-chain chapter; figure 5.10 panel B reports regional source shares for imported intermediate inputs, based on 2018 input-output data. Prior generated 18:50:00Z retrieval field was unsupported (it postdated the rejection snapshot); exact UTC time was not preserved. Corrected to date-only precision from the execution date; no observation values changed.
sources.units: Percent of imported intermediate inputs by source region
sources.scopeAndLimits: OECD reports EU 54%, Asia 17%, North America 10%, rest of Europe 8%, other 11% of imported intermediate inputs averaged across Swiss sectors, based on 2018 input-output data. This is a lagged structural dependency, not a current-year bilateral gross trade value, a financial exposure, or an identified causal effect.

sources.title: WorldCom, Inc. 2002 Form 10-K with restated FY2001 financial statements
sources.observedPeriod: Restated year ended 2001-12-31; comparative 2000; reorganization filings through 2002
sources.revision: SEC-filed 2002 Form 10-K, filed 2004-03-09, audited by KPMG after restatement. Extracted cash, debt, restatement and impairment values use the filing’s restated FY2001 statements and debt note. Prior generated 18:50:00Z retrieval field was unsupported (it postdated the rejection snapshot); exact UTC time was not preserved. Corrected to date-only precision from the execution date; no observation values changed.
sources.units: USD millions unless stated
sources.scopeAndLimits: WorldCom was a diversified telecom operator with major acquisition activity and accounting fraud/restatement. Its filing states a $70.8bn cumulative equity reduction from restatement adjustments as of 2001 and restated PP&E/intangibles; it is not a clean causal observation of fiber overbuild losses.

sources.title: Level 3 Communications 2001 Form 10-K
sources.observedPeriod: Fiscal year ended 2001-12-31; financing and business-plan disclosures through filing date in 2002
sources.revision: SEC-filed annual report PDF. Filing reports 2001 capex of $2.3bn, total funds available at year end of $2.1bn including cash/marketable securities and undrawn secured facility, and $13–14bn cumulative funding requirement to cash-flow breakeven. Prior generated 18:50:00Z retrieval field was unsupported (it postdated the rejection snapshot); exact UTC time was not preserved. Corrected to date-only precision from the execution date; no observation values changed.
sources.units: USD billions, company-reported
sources.scopeAndLimits: An ambitious fiber-network entrant that later required financial restructuring; management projections are contemporaneous expectations, not outcomes. Values are not directly comparable to WorldCom consolidated results or current hyperscalers.

sources.title: Verizon Communications 2001 Form 10-K
sources.observedPeriod: Fiscal year ended 2001-12-31
sources.revision: SEC filing detail; FY2001 Form 10-K and annual report listed in accession 0000950109-02-001438. Financial statements are a surviving integrated local-access/wireless incumbent comparator, not a matched competitive fiber entrant. Re-fetched the SEC 10-K text and its SEC Exhibit 13 annual report at 2026-10-14T17:20:37Z and 17:20:46Z UTC respectively; the statements/Note 14 tables were extracted for cash, debt, OCF, capex and maturity schedule. Raw SEC text and retrieval metadata are archived in retrievals/verizon/.
sources.units: Company statements in USD millions
sources.scopeAndLimits: The Verizon group had regulated/local-access and wireless operations, unlike a pure long-haul fiber entrant. Filing identity verified, but no comparable utilization measure or normalized cash/debt schedule extracted in this repair; no direct cash-flow ranking is claimed.

sources.title: UN Comtrade annual merchandise trade by reporter, partner and flow (2024 selected bilateral series)
sources.observedPeriod: Calendar year 2024; annual total merchandise exports; selected reporter-partner directions
sources.revision: UN Comtrade public preview API, classification HS, annual frequency, commodity TOTAL, flow X. Selected 12 directed queries retrieved 17:19:25Z–17:20:06Z; raw responses retained one file per request. Reporter codes: 842 US, 156 China, 97 EU, 756 Switzerland.
sources.units: Current USD, primaryValue; converted to USD billions by dividing by 1,000,000,000
sources.scopeAndLimits: Reported gross merchandise exports, not services, value-added trade, net exposure or financial claims. Reporter/partner mirror values differ. HTTP 200 with count=0 is retained as no returned observation, not zero. EU aggregate is Comtrade reporter code 97; Swiss code 756 requests returned count=0 for the queried pair directions.

sources.title: Extra-EU trade by partner (Eurostat Comext dataset ext_lt_maineu)
sources.observedPeriod: Annual EU27 extra-EU trade by partner; 2024 values; API dataset vintage last updated 2026-09-15
sources.revision: Endpoint was queried in this closure: one successful dimensionless-by-indicator query returned the US partner series, but the response body was not durably captured; later one-call multi-partner query returned HTTP 200 with zero selected partner cells. No Eurostat value is used in the closure table. Date-only retrieval precision retained because the exact retrieval time for the successful query was not logged.
sources.units: Dataset provides exports/imports and trade balance in million EUR
sources.scopeAndLimits: Official alternative to OECD ICIO for EU goods trade. This attempt is logged as a source-search outcome, not a numeric observation; raw successful response was not archived, so no value is carried into baseline.
